Marsriva KP3 EC 8400mAh – Mini Smart DC UPS in Bangladesh

Buy the Marsriva KP3 EC 8400mAh Mini Smart DC UPS online in Bangladesh at the best price from dcores.net. Designed for uninterrupted power supply, this compact and intelligent DC UPS is the perfect solution for routers, modems, CCTV cameras, and other low-power electronic devices.


Key Features of Marsriva KP3 EC 8400mAh DC UPS

  • High-Capacity Battery: Built-in 8400mAh (3.6V) lithium battery ensures long backup during power outages.
  • Multiple Output Ports:   3x DC Outputs: 12V/1.5A, 9V/2.0A, 5V/2.0A     1x USB Output: 5V/2.0A
  • Zero Transfer Time: 0ms AC to DC switchover guarantees no interruption to your connected devices.
  • Compact & Lightweight Design: Easy to carry and install. Ideal for home and office use.
  • Safe & Reliable: V-0 flame-retardant casing and built-in air-cooling system for enhanced safety and durability.
  • Wall-Mountable: Comes with wall-mount slots for space-saving installation.
  • Low Power Consumption: Energy-efficient and environmentally friendly design.
